newsitem.title: IRAN: Intelligence nominee wants all Iranians as agents.
newsitem.headline: Intelligence nominee wants all Iranians as agents.

text.p: Iran's intelligence minister designate said on Tuesday he wanted all Iranians to be agents for the ministry.

"The ministry should indeed have 60 million employees. We are the eyes and ears of the people and vice versa," Qorbanali Dorri Najafabadi, named as intelligence (internal security) minister by President Mohammad Khatami, told reporters.
"We seek a constructive and positive presence in the region and the world," said Dorri Najafabadi, speaking in parliament where deputies held a debate on cabinet nominees.
"Foreigners can live in Iran with peace of mind. They are our guests and their freedoms are guaranteed," he added.
Parliament is scheduled to vote on Khatami's 22-member cabinet list on Wednesday.

If approved, Dorri Najafabadi would replace Ali Fallahiyan, against whom Germany last year issued an arrest warrant for his alleged role in killings of dissidents in Berlin. Iran has denied involvement in the killings.
